spine: 1. 虛擬化長列表的標準做法是只掛載可視範圍內的列、捲動時回收 DOM 元素——這對高度固定、事先算得出來的程式碼列很容易;但審查留言區塊的高度只有渲染後才知道,而且渲染完之後還可能繼續變,原本『每列高度可預期』的假設在這裡失效。GitHub 拿來驗證的壓力測試案例是一個開源 PR:2,200 個檔案、超過一百萬行改動、400 多則審查留言。

2. GitHub 把整份文件的高度拆成兩個獨立系統:總高度 = 確定的程式碼高度(精確、事先算好)+ 所有動態區塊的有效高度總和(先估計、再量測)+ 捲動用的 padding。程式碼幾何是決定性的、prefix-summed、精確,留言改高度也不需要重算;動態區塊幾何管所有沒辦法預先知道高度的東西(審查留言串、草稿、回覆輸入框)。一個區塊的有效高度依序取:已量測的高度、fingerprint 與寬度都吻合時的快取高度、估計值。

3. 他們原本設計、後來在效能硬化階段推翻的做法,是每個動態區塊各掛一個 ResizeObserver——因為一個把高度寫回自己正在觀察的元素的 observer 會觸發自己重新觸發,而且成本隨掛載的區塊數一路增加。上線的做法是單一個 idle- 與 scroll-gated 的量測 pass,只在可視範圍穩定下來時跑一次,絕不是每個捲動 frame 都跑一次,且捲動進行中完全不跑;候選範圍只鎖在視窗附近約 2400px 內,工作量因此是 O(viewport)。
4. 高度修正落地前,先用身分(而非座標)記住使用者當下錨定的列或區塊,以及其中的偏移量;套用高度差之後,把同一個錨點解回新的像素位置,再捲動畫面讓錨點留在原本的位置。已掛載且在畫面上的區塊,量到新高度時會在同一個 frame、繪製前就地套用修正,但受兩個安全閥限制:每個 frame 最多一次同步 commit(一串 resize 收斂成一次),且捲動進行中絕不做,退回批次 pass。
5. diff 是漸進式請求的,檔案樹與 metadata 在文件還在載入時就先畫出來,所有審查留言串一次解析完不會慢慢跑出來。離開一份 diff 就整個釋放是對的預設行為,但 PR metadata 會留著,回到分頁時外殼(header、檔案樹)能立刻打開;後來團隊加上快取,留著最近瀏覽過的幾份 diff 常駐,超過就淘汰,背景刷新會自己發現哪一份已經過期。

6. 這套系統靠一支headless probe 對著 mock server 跑固定流程(開 PR、捲到某個比例、展開 detail 區塊、調整視窗大小)找出來,探針自己跑完 instrument、drive、collect、analyze、rank 整個循環並印出排序好的瓶頸;另有 autopilot 在真正的桌面 App 上無人值守、反覆跑同一段流程確認問題在真實環境重現。整個開發迴圈總結成四句話:在真引擎上無人值守地重現、用健康訊號而非肉眼偵測、對可疑接縫探測、把鷹架程式碼拆掉。
7. 六個決定各自處理一個具體的失效模式(程式碼與留言分兩套幾何系統、量測綁在 idle/scroll-gated、身分錨定、單一同步 commit 且不在捲動中做、diff 漸進載入加快取、探測工具用完即拆),合起來讓一個 2,200 個檔案、破百萬行、400 多則留言的 PR 捲動起來跟小 PR 一樣順;對任何做可捲動且列高不固定清單的前端工程師,這些原則可以直接抽出來用。

perspective.mechanism: 把畫面高度拆成兩個獨立幾何系統(程式碼確定性 prefix-sum、動態區塊估計→量測→快取),量測本身用單一個 idle- 與 scroll-gated 的批次 pass(取代每區塊各掛一個會自我觸發的 ResizeObserver),範圍鎖在視窗附近約 2400px 內達到 O(viewport);高度修正落地時靠身分而非座標錨定使用者視線,且受『每 frame 最多一次同步 commit、捲動中絕不做』兩個安全閥約束;diff 漸進載入、PR metadata 獨立於 diff 文件快取之外常駐;整套系統靠 headless probe(對 mock server)與 autopilot(對真引擎)組成的無人值守量測—改善循環開發出來。
perspective.tradeoff: 程式碼列的虛擬化因為高度確定性而幾乎無成本,但同一套邏輯套用到高度不確定、渲染後還會變的留言區塊上就整個失效,必須另建一套系統;per-block ResizeObserver 直覺但會自我觸發、成本隨掛載數量增加,換成單一批次 pass 犧牲了『即時反應』換取『工作量可控』,因此又需要另一層『在畫面上的區塊同幀就地修正』的機制來補即時性,並用兩個安全閥防止它退化回原本被推翻的迴圈;錨定用身分不用座標,換取的是修正落地時視覺不跳動,但需要多記一份錨點狀態。
perspective.reader_use: 任何要做『可捲動、列高不固定』清單的前端工程師,可以直接把這篇拆解的判斷順序搬過去用:先分清楚哪些列的高度真正算得出來、哪些只能先估,不要混在同一套邏輯裡量測;量測動態內容前先問『一次全部量測夠不夠』,不要預設每個元素都得各自掛一個 observer;捲動進行中不做任何會動版面的同步修正;修正落地前後永遠先確認使用者眼睛盯著哪個元素、記住它的身分而非座標。

notes.quote: an open source one with 2,200 files, over a million changed lines, and more than 400 inline review comments
notes.interpretation: GitHub 拿來壓力測試的真實案例規模,是全文所有具體數字敘述(hero opener、H2-1、closer)的依據。

notes.quote: You cannot put a million DOM nodes on a page. The standard answer is virtualization: mount only the rows that are on screen, plus a small margin, and recycle those same DOM elements as the user scrolls.
notes.interpretation: 虛擬化的標準定義,用於 H2-1 開場段落。

notes.quote: But if every row is a line of code at a known font size, you don't have to. You can compute the whole table up front and it never changes.
notes.interpretation: 程式碼列高度確定、可一次算完的依據。

notes.quote: Now put a review thread in the middle of the diff. How tall is it? You don't know, and you can't know without rendering it.
notes.interpretation: 審查留言串高度不可預先得知的依據。

notes.quote: Its height depends on things that only exist at render time, and they can keep changing after first paint.
notes.interpretation: 留言區塊高度在渲染後仍可能繼續變化的依據。

notes.quote: total height = deterministic code height (exact, known up front) + Σ dynamic block effective heights (estimated, then measured) + scroll padding
notes.interpretation: 兩何模型的核心公式,原文以多行格式呈現,此處正規化為單行引用;是 H2-2 開場與 css-3d widget figcaption 的依據。

notes.quote: Code geometry keeps the original world. It's deterministic, prefix-summed, exact, never rebuilt when a comment resizes.
notes.interpretation: 程式碼幾何的定義,用於 H2-2 段落與 css-3d widget 標籤/figcaption。

notes.quote: Dynamic block geometry covers everything whose height we can't predict, such as review threads, drafts, and reply composers.
notes.interpretation: 動態區塊幾何的定義,用於 H2-2 段落與 css-3d widget 標籤/figcaption。

notes.quote: A block's effective height is then simple: the measured height if we have a valid one, a cached height if the fingerprint and width still match, and the estimate otherwise.
notes.interpretation: 區塊有效高度的三態取值規則,用於 H2-2 第二段。

notes.quote: The obvious way to measure dynamic content is one ResizeObserver per block, which watches the element and writes its measured height back into the layout whenever it changes. This is what we designed and then rejected during performance hardening.
notes.interpretation: per-block ResizeObserver 被設計又被推翻的直接依據,用於 H2-3 第一段。

notes.quote: An observer that writes a height back into the layout of the element it's watching can retrigger itself, and the cost grows with every mounted block.
notes.interpretation: per-block ResizeObserver 自我觸發與成本隨掛載數增加的依據。

notes.quote: What shipped instead is a single idle- and scroll-gated measurement pass, held to the same discipline as the deterministic side
notes.interpretation: 上線做法的定義,用於 H2-3 第二段。

notes.quote: It runs when the visible range settles, never once per scroll frame, and waits entirely while a scroll is in flight.
notes.interpretation: 單一量測 pass 的觸發時機規則。

notes.quote: Only blocks within roughly 2400px of the viewport are candidates, so the work is O(viewport).
notes.interpretation: 量測候選範圍與複雜度上限的依據,用於 range-input-binding widget。原文用『roughly』修飾 2400px 這個數字。

notes.quote: Before applying height updates, capture what the user is anchored to (a row or a block, by identity), plus the offset within it. Apply the height deltas. Resolve that same anchor to its new pixel position. Scroll so the anchor stays put in the viewport.
notes.interpretation: scroll anchoring 四步驟順序,用於 H2-4 第一段與 hero widget figcaption。

notes.quote: When a block is mounted and on screen, the observer now measures it and applies the correction in the same frame, before paint.
notes.interpretation: 已掛載在畫面上的區塊,量測與修正在同一 frame、繪製前完成的依據,用於 H2-4 第三段。

notes.quote: Two safeguards keep this from becoming the loop we were avoiding: at most one synchronous commit per frame, so a burst of resizes collapses into one, and never during an active scroll, where it falls back to the batched pass.
notes.interpretation: 兩個安全閥的具體內容,用於 H2-4 第三段。

notes.quote: The diff is requested incrementally, so the file tree and metadata paint while the document is still loading, and the full set of review threads is resolved up front rather than trickling in.
notes.interpretation: diff 漸進載入與留言串一次解析完的依據,用於 H2-5 第一段。

notes.quote: Releasing a diff document when you navigate away is the right default
notes.interpretation: 離開一份 diff 就釋放是預設行為的依據,用於 H2-5 第二段。

notes.quote: pull request metadata persists, so the shell around the diff, the header and the file tree, repaints instantly when you go back
notes.interpretation: PR metadata 獨立常駐、回頁時外殼秒開的依據,用於 H2-5 第二段與 stack-cards widget detail-4。

notes.quote: keep the last few diffs resident, evict anything beyond that, and let the background refresh notice when one has gone stale
notes.interpretation: diff 快取政策(留幾份常駐、超過淘汰、背景刷新偵測過期),原文未寫死具體留幾份;用於 H2-5 第二段與 stack-cards widget detail-2/3。

notes.quote: A headless probe lane ran a declarative flow (open a pull request, scroll to a fraction, toggle a details block, resize the window) against a mock server.
notes.interpretation: headless probe 的固定流程描述,用於 H2-6 第一段。

notes.quote: It did the whole instrument, drive, collect, analyze, rank cycle by itself and printed the bottlenecks in order.
notes.interpretation: 探針自動跑完整套循環並排序瓶頸的依據,用於 H2-6 第二段。

notes.quote: An autopilot drove the actual desktop app through the huge-pull-request flow, unattended, on a loop.
notes.interpretation: autopilot 在真引擎上無人值守反覆跑的依據,用於 H2-6 第一段。

notes.quote: The loop we ran was: Reproduce unattended, on the real engine. Detect with a health signal, not with your eyes. Probe the suspect seam. Remove the scaffolding.
notes.interpretation: 四步驟開發迴圈的總結,用於 H2-6 第二段與 canvas loop widget 標籤/figcaption。

notes.quote: Alberto Gimeno — September 23, 2026
notes.interpretation: 文章作者與發布日期的頁面 byline 資訊(WebFetch 結構化摘要呈現;非引號內逐字句原文排版,此處僅記錄供追溯),用於 sidecar sources 與 ledger 的 published 欄位。集群簡報本身已提供作者與日期(GitHub, Alberto Gimeno, Sep 23, 2026)。

notes.quote: We also keep a fingerprint of everything that could change the block's height: its content, whether a `<details>` is open, whether a composer is active. And we record the width it was last measured at, rounded into buckets, so an ordinary window resize doesn't invalidate every measurement in the document.
notes.interpretation: 修正 c10 trace failure:fingerprint 涵蓋內容、details 是否展開、composer 是否啟用;寬度是量測當下記錄、捲進桶(bucket)裡的值,一般的視窗縮放不會讓它跟著變,因此不會讓整份文件的量測結果一次失效。原文未說快取失效後『回到量測』——per n09,快取沒命中時退回的是估計值,不是重新量測。用於 H2-2 第二段。

notes.quote: The result is a pull request view where a million-line diff with hundreds of threaded comments opens, scrolls, and behaves like a normally sized pull request.
notes.interpretation: 修正 c32 trace failure 與過度陳述:文章的結論句,描述的是 PR 檢視畫面『開啟、捲動、表現得像一般大小的 PR』,主體是 GitHub Copilot App(桌面應用程式),原文從未提到瀏覽器情境。用於閉合段(closer)。

notes.quote: An autopilot drove the actual desktop app through the huge-pull-request flow, unattended, on a loop: first cold, with comments still skeletons, then warm, with comments loaded, toggling `<details>` blocks, opening and cancelling reply composers, collapsing and expanding files, toggling the sidebar tree, sweeping deep into the file list, resizing the window.
notes.interpretation: 補齊 n24 被截斷的下半句:autopilot 分兩階段跑(留言還是骨架的冷啟動狀態、留言全部載入完的熱狀態),過程中涵蓋展開 detail 區塊、開關回覆框、收合展開檔案、切換側邊欄等操作。用於 H2-6 第一段,取代原本 c29 被判定 unverifiable 的『確認同樣的問題在真實環境裡也重現』『真正上線前再跑一次確認』敘述。

claims.evidence: What shipped instead is a single idle- and scroll-gated measurement pass, held to the same discipline as the deterministic side: / It runs when the visible range settles, never once per scroll frame, and waits entirely while a scroll is in flight.

claims.claim_text: 候選範圍鎖在視窗附近大約 2400px 以內，工作量跟視窗大小成正比——原文直接寫成 O(viewport)

claims.claim_text: 先記住使用者當下錨定在哪一列或哪一個區塊——用身分而不是座標記住，再記下在那個元素裡的偏移量。等高度差套用完，再把同一個錨點解回它新的像素位置，最後捲動畫面，讓這個錨點留在使用者原本看到的地方

claims.evidence: Before applying height updates, capture what the user is anchored to (a row or a block, by identity), plus the offset within it. Apply the height deltas. Resolve that same anchor to its new pixel position. Scroll so the anchor stays put in the viewport.

claims.claim_text: N = 60px 時，沒有錨定畫面會跳 60px；有錨定畫面跳動 0px

claims.claim_text: 已經掛載、且在畫面上的區塊，量到新高度時，會在同一個 frame、繪製前就地套用修正……每個 frame 最多套用一次同步 commit，一連串的 resize 收斂成一次；捲動進行中絕對不做，退回批次的那條 pass 處理
